section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section defines body image as a multidimensional construct, noting a historical focus on appearance dissatisfaction and a more recent shift towards positive body image. The purpose of this study is to examine how both negative and positive aspects of body image contribute to sexual health among an age-varied sample of adult women, specifically comparing appearance dissatisfaction to body appreciation.
